title: Daily Breakfast Oats
description: A fiber-packed, cholesterol-conscious breakfast bowl featuring cooked oats, chia seeds, protein powder, and fresh toppings.
steps: Cook the oats beforehand to create resistant starch.
In a small cup, combine chia seeds with almond milk.
Mix the cooked oats with the chia seed mixture, cinnamon, vegan protein powder, and honey using a whisk.
Crush the frozen raspberries into the oats.
Top with optional freeze dried strawberries for crunch.
notes:
Keep flaxseed in the fridge to preserve delicate omegas. You can also prepare this as overnight oats by keeping it cold.

Source: https://www.facebook.com/share/v/19GtMX34pe/

Nutrition: Serving 1 bowl · Calories 450 kcal · Fat 12g · Saturated fat 1g · Unsaturated fat 10g · Trans fat 0g · Cholesterol 0mg · Sodium 150mg · Carbs 65g · Fiber 15g · Sugar 18g · Protein 25g

healthy: Oats, chia and flaxseed give lots of fiber.
Raspberries and strawberries add fruit and vitamins.
Protein powder adds protein, and chia and flax add omega-3 fats.
not_healthy: Protein powder is a processed ingredient.
